description: Defines the StreamWrapper class that converts Guzzle streams into PHP stream resources, providing methods for stream management and interaction.

classes.name: StreamWrapper
classes.description: Converts Guzzle streams into PHP stream resources, enabling stream operations via PHP's stream wrapper interface.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns a PHP resource for the given Guzzle stream, registering the stream wrapper if necessary.

methods.name: createStreamContext
methods.description: Creates a stream context for the Guzzle stream to be used with PHP stream functions.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the 'guzzle' stream wrapper if it is not already registered.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Opens a stream using the context's Guzzle stream.

methods.name: stream_tell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the stream.

methods.name: stream_eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at EOF.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in the stream.

methods.name: stream_stat
methods.description: Returns status info about the stream.

methods.name: url_stat
methods.description: Returns status info about a URL.
